details.completeness_justification: All eight key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S2 (revenue growth), S6 (EBITDA loss improvement), and S11 (H2 positive EBITDA). K2 is covered by S17 (CARR growth, new sales, CAC payback) and S19 (churn rate). K3 is covered by S20 (product suite expansion). K4 is covered by S4 (new customers and geographic expansion). K5 is covered by S8 and S9 (cost reductions and efficiency measures). K6 is covered by S13 and S15 (private placements and equity positions). K7 is covered by S21 (2026 guidance targets). K8 is covered by S4 (Iberia expansion and new markets). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support the overall narrative of improved financial performance in 2025. There are no self-contradictions: profitability metrics (EBITDA, EBIT, net loss) consistently show improvement. The revenue growth explanations (subscription, onboarding/consulting) align with stated customer metrics. Cost reduction initiatives are clearly described and tied to operating efficiency. Strategic developments (Konsolidator Suite launch) and future guidance are presented without conflicting with past performance statements. While some metrics show mixed signals (e.g., ARR churn increase vs. net retention), these are presented as separate facts without contradiction. The structure flows logically from overall performance to revenue breakdown, profitability, cost management, cash flow, and future guidance.
